availability_verbatim: Nationwide (excludes NY & FL and any other state without a branch unless existing relationship)

requirements.verbatim: Complete two or more direct deposits within 90 days totaling $4,000 to $7,999.99 to earn $300, or $8,000+ to earn $600
Enroll in U.S. Bank Mobile App or online banking within 90 days of opening
Account must be funded with at least $25 within 60 days to prevent closure

fee_waiver: Waived with $1,500+ monthly direct deposits, $1,500 avg balance, small business checking ownership, eligible customer group, Smart Rewards Gold+, or Bank Smartly Visa Signature/State Farm card ownership

churn.limit_language_verbatim: Not eligible if you or any owner have an existing/had-in-last-12-months U.S. Bank consumer checking account or received other US Bank consumer checking bonus in past 12 months

notes: This is a targeted (non-transferable) offer - eligibility shown only when logged in if targeted. Bonus credited within 60 days following completion of all requirements ('adjusted interest'). No update markers present in this post.
